name: Environment: Tropical Rainforests
summary: Funds work that keeps tropical rainforests standing by stopping deforestation, mostly strategic policy work but also local projects run by Indigenous peoples and local communities over large areas. Applications go by email to the foundation.

steps: Further review and discussion, if taken forward

eligibility.rule: Local projects tackle deforestation drivers, manage and monitor the area, and secure livelihoods and land rights
No tree planting, stove-only, animal-only, research, environmental education, REDD or carbon finance projects
Project is based in a secure and politically stable country
Only one application per organisation at a time

documents: Referee contact details, if based outside the UK

calls.label: Twice-yearly deadlines
calls.recurring: Deadlines on 1 June and 1 November every year

status.quote: The 2 deadlines for applications to our Tropical Rainforests programme fall on the following dates every year: 1st November 1st June

recurring.quote: The 2 deadlines for applications to our Tropical Rainforests programme fall on the following dates every year: 1st November 1st June

applicant_types.quote: We prioritise providing funding support to UK-based charities, many of whom work in close partnership with smaller local NGOs based in the countries in which they operate.

access.quote: Please note that all applications must be submitted to applications@waterloofoundation.org.uk.

window.quote: Each year we have 2 deadlines per programme for applications to our Environment Fund.

effort.quote: Limit the proposal to approximately 2-3 sides of A4, and send it as an attachment to an email to applications@waterloofoundation.org.uk.
If your funding application is able to be taken forward to be reviewed in more detail, we will then contact you to discuss it further.

eligibility.quote: Applicants will need to demonstrate how their project involves: Exposing, addressing and overcoming the local drivers of deforestation Management of the specified area Methods to measure and monitor the protected area Sustainable livelihoods for forest-dependent communities Securing land rights or management rights for forest-dependent communities

Tree planting projects Projects focused solely on the use of fuel-efficient stoves Projects with animal conservation as the sole focus Research projects Projects focusing on environmental education We are currently not accepting proposals for REDD and carbon finance projects
Projects based in countries that are not secure and politically stable.
We will only consider one application per organisation at any one time.

after_award.quote: If the grant offer is for two or more years, we will require you to send an annual monitoring report before issuing each further yearly instalment.

documents.quote: If you are an organisation based outside of the UK you must provide us with a reference for your work (see FAQs for details).
